title: When to repeat the reminder to commit the one-time cleanup (untracked agents, removed startup file)
context: After an upgrade, paqad asks the lead to commit one cleanup (the paqad helpers it stopped tracking and the removed startup file .paqad/hook.mjs) in a single message. If the lead does not commit it, when should paqad remind them? Without a reminder the old files stay shared and every teammate keeps receiving them; too many reminders become noise in every session. Grounded in docs/modules/adapter-onboarding/features/claude-code/business.md.

options.label: On every update the lead runs by hand until it is committed, never at session start (recommended)
options.one_line_preview: On every update the lead runs by hand until it is committed, never at session start (recommended)
